data.name: Haybora
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hayb' meaning 'mountain goat', symbolizing strength, courage, and protection. In Swahili, it is also known as 'Mbulamutu', which translates to 'he who walks on mountains'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the journey towards inner strength and resilience, overcoming challenges with grace and determination.
